verify.name: Generated PNG files are parseable
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
assets = {
    'background_world_layer_v2': {'min_w': 640, 'min_h': 360, 'alpha_required': False},
    'player_avatar_v2': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'goal_marker_v2': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'hazard_marker_v2': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'collectible_item_v2': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'safe_platform_tile_v2': {'min_w': 128, 'min_h': 128, 'alpha_required': True},
    'ui_status_panel_v2': {'min_w': 256, 'min_h': 96, 'alpha_required': True},
}
for asset_id, rule in assets.items():
    path = f'game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/{asset_id}.png'
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        assert f.read(8) == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', path
        length = struct.unpack('>I', f.read(4))[0]
        assert f.read(4) == b'IHDR', path
        data = f.read(length)
        width, height, bit_depth, color_type = struct.unpack('>IIBB', data[:10])[:4]
        assert width >= rule['min_w'] and height >= rule['min_h'], (path, width, height)
        if rule['alpha_required']:
            assert color_type in (4, 6), (path, 'expected alpha-capable PNG color type', color_type)
print('png ok')
PY

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the regenerated v2 prototype art assets before any implementation Work Package may integrate them into the Godot playable scene.
acceptance_criteria: All previous direct_art v1 assets are treated as failed playable-art direction evidence and are not overwritten.

A complete regenerated v2 prototype asset set is produced under game/assets/phase4b/direct_art_v2/**: one coherent background world layer, player avatar, goal marker, hazard marker, collectible item, safe platform tile, and UI status panel.

PerfectPixel Studio is installed from https://github.com/Canine89/perfectpixel-studio/tree/openai-gpt-image-2-support outside this repository and is treated as the preferred generation pipeline when a supported provider key is available.
PerfectPixel usage records provider, model, branch, commit, prompt, output path, and any post-processing or export path for each asset when it is used.
OpenAI GPT Image 2 support is used through PerfectPixel when OPENAI_API_KEY is available; the key must not be printed, committed, or stored in this repository.
Because BK explicitly authorized continuation without setting an OpenAI key, the built-in Codex imagegen skill may be used as the fallback generation path for WP-039.
Built-in imagegen fallback usage records prompt, generated source path, local chroma-key removal path where applicable, output path, and prototype-only status for each asset.
The v2 art direction prioritizes gameplay visual hierarchy: Player > Goal > Hazard = Item > Safe platform > HUD/status > Background.
Hazard and item have equal hierarchy but must be distinguishable by silhouette first, color second, and label last.
The background is a single coherent Background World Layer and must not include platform-like, hazard-like, collectible-like, or goal-like foreground props.
Gameplay roles are readable without depending on labels; labels may remain prototype aids but cannot be the primary readability mechanism.
The asset set may share one art style, but gameplay object separation must be visible at prototype scale.
The regenerated assets remain prototype-only / production-candidate and are not final art direction, production asset approval, launch usage, or public release approval.

No Godot scene, script, project config, gameplay logic, level layout, movement, collision, QA review, Learning Card promotion, staging, committing, pushing, merging, or deployment is performed by WP-039 execution.
A Korean owner review brief is created so BK can evaluate the regenerated v2 asset set before any implementation Work Package uses it.
The result is handed off to Implementation only after BK approves or conditionally approves the v2 art set for prototype integration.
notes: BK/Human Creative Owner determined that the Phase 4B direct art integration technically passed art application but completely failed as a playable game because gameplay objects were not visually separated and the background did not behave as one coherent lower-priority world layer. WP-039 regenerates all assets rather than preserving v1 art, but does not reject the Direct Art Production Pipeline itself. PerfectPixel Studio on the openai-gpt-image-2-support branch was installed and verified first, but BK later authorized built-in Codex imagegen fallback because OPENAI_API_KEY cannot be configured in the current remote SSH context.
